welcome.title: Your day has tides.
welcome.subtitle: A few quick questions and we'll build a plan that fits you. Takes about two minutes.
welcome.value1Body: Log meals by photo, text or barcode. møni does the rest.
welcome.value2Body: Your daily level rises with every session.
welcome.value3Body: Your plan learns from your real progress.

name.title: First things first — what should we call you?
name.subtitle: Your first name is perfect. We'll use it to make møni feel like yours.

motivation.title: What's driving you, {{name}}?
motivation.subtitle: Pick the one that matters most — we'll keep it in mind.
motivation.lookDescription: Feel at home in your body

sex.title: What's your sex?
sex.subtitle: Needed for an accurate calorie formula (Mifflin-St Jeor).

birthDate.title: When's your birthday?
birthDate.subtitle: Your metabolism changes with age, so this makes your numbers more precise.
birthDate.label: Birth date

body.title: Height & weight
body.subtitle: We use this to work out your base energy. Nothing more.

activity.title: How active is your everyday life?
activity.subtitle: Outside of workouts — we count those separately, so nothing gets counted twice.
activity.lightDescription: On your feet sometimes, light walking
activity.moderateDescription: Regularly on your feet, some physical work

goal.title: What do you want to achieve?
goal.subtitle: This decides whether we aim for a deficit, maintenance, or a surplus.
goal.gainDescription: Gradual calorie surplus, ideal for building muscle

targetWeight.title: What's your goal weight?
targetWeight.subtitle: Pick a target that feels good — you can change it any time.
targetWeight.projection: At your current pace you'll get there around {{date}}.
targetWeight.warnUnderweight: That's below a healthy BMI of 18.5. A slightly higher target is kinder to your body.
targetWeight.warnTooLow: That target is too low to be healthy for your height.
targetWeight.noRange: You're already at the lower end of a healthy weight for your height. Maybe “Maintain” is the better goal?

rate.title: How fast do you want to go?
rate.subtitleMaintain: You're maintaining, so there's no rate to set.
rate.paceGentleHint: Very doable. Slow and steady goes furthest.
rate.paceBalancedHint: A good balance between progress and everyday life.
rate.paceAggressiveHint: Demanding, and it can cost muscle. We’d suggest a slightly calmer pace.
rate.capped: For your safety we cap this at about {{value}} per week.

experience.title: How much training experience do you have?
experience.subtitle: So we can pitch things at the right level.
experience.beginnerDescription: New to it, or back after a long break
experience.intermediateDescription: Training regularly for a few months

schedule.title: Training days
schedule.subtitle: How many times a week do you train, and on which days? On those days your level rises.

diet.title: How do you eat?
diet.subtitle: Helps us make suggestions that fit your plate.
diet.flexitarianDescription: Mostly plant-based, meat now and then

disclaimer.title: One important note
disclaimer.subtitle: Before we crunch your numbers:
disclaimer.point1: møni gives estimates and general guidance — not medical advice.
disclaimer.point2: If you're pregnant, have a medical condition or a history of eating disorders, please talk to a doctor before changing your diet.
disclaimer.point3: We never go below safe calorie minimums and we cap aggressive deficits.

result.title: {{name}}, your plan is ready.
result.subtitle: Your daily level is your calorie amount for today. Training lifts it; on rest days it eases.

motivation.health: Built to help you feel healthier, day by day.
motivation.look: Built to help you feel great in your own skin.
motivation.performance: Built so your performance can grow.
motivation.energy: Built to keep your energy up all day.
motivation.confidence: Built to help you trust your body again.

result.projectionNote: An estimate based on your pace. Your plan adapts as you log your weight.
result.explanation: On rest days your level is your adjusted maintenance. On training days we add back a share of what you use, mostly as carbs, since protein and fat stay steady.
result.guardrailDeficit: Your requested pace was steeper than a safe deficit (max 25% below maintenance), so we capped it.
result.guardrailSurplus: Your requested pace was steeper than a safe surplus (max +500 kcal/day), so we capped it.
result.guardrailMinimum: Your target hit the safe daily minimum, so we raised it slightly.
result.holdHint: Hold the circle until it fills.
result.holdA11yHint: Double tap and hold to start your plan

health.title: Connect Apple Health
health.subtitle: møni works even better with Health:
health.benefit1: Import workouts from your Apple Watch and other apps
health.benefit2: Keep your weight in sync automatically
health.benefit3: More accurate calories burned on training days
health.privacy: You decide exactly what møni may read and write. Change it any time in Settings.
health.denied: No problem — you can connect Health later in your profile.

notifications.title: Gentle reminders?
notifications.subtitle: At most one a day, off any time.
notifications.denied: Okay! You can turn reminders on later in your profile.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to save your targets and start tracking.
signIn.signUpSubtitle: Create your free account so your plan is saved safely.
signIn.signInSubtitle: Sign in to pick up where you left off.
signIn.toggleToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in

otp.title: Sign in with a code
otp.subtitle: We'll email you a 6-digit code — no password, no link to tap.

signIn.socialComingSoon: Coming soon — needs an Apple Developer account
signIn.checkEmail: Check your inbox to confirm your email, then sign in.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

applying.title: Setting up your plan…
applying.error: We couldn't save your plan. Check your connection and try again.

personal.name: Name
personal.remindersDenied: Notifications are turned off for møni. You can allow them in the iOS Settings app.

profile.eatBackFactorDescription: How much of your training use gets added to your level.
profile.signOutConfirmMessage: You can sign back in any time.
